items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I'd go to the union building and throw one over for Mr. Dillman.

ctx.x: Who were you with? In the Depression? Yeah.

I was playing for myself in the Depression. I was working for myself. I'd get out there and work and unload cold cars. I'd catch a job playing, go to the lake or something like that, you know? And I'd play them picnics. You still unload them cold cars? I'd unload gondola cars by myself. I unload two a day by myself. One at night and one in the day. I'd unload it for George Kelly. I'd wheel it out. I was only making $10 a car. $10? That's all I made. Them big gondolas. Them big gondolas. I'd unload one in the day…
